name: I.B.I.- Managing & Underwriting Ltd
summary: I.B.I.- Managing & Underwriting Ltd operates as a comprehensive investment banking firm, offering a range of financial services. The company assists corporations in raising both equity and debt capital by facilitating the issuance of securities in the capital markets. Its responsibilities encompass the end-to-end management of these public offerings, including the strategic distribution of securities and the coordination of consortium underwriters. Furthermore, the company engages in securities brokerage and arranges private placements of corporate issues directly with institutional investors. Established in 1993, the firm, headquartered in Tel Aviv-Yafo, Israel, was previously known as Poalim I.B.I.-Managing & Underwriting Ltd.
